takeoverPolicy.emptySeatFill: At lobby lock, fill remaining unique character seats until at least six adventurers are present.
takeoverPolicy.disconnect: After the game-defined grace period, a bot takes over the exact character, Game Level, D&D-equivalent snapshot, HP, inventory, evidence hand, notebook, resources, limited-power uses, and current position.

takeoverPolicy.secretContinuity: The bot inherits only the disconnected seat’s legitimate private information and hidden role. The returning human is not shown bot-private reasoning logs.

innocentVersion.personalityCore: Jock is charming, observant, dramatic, and always aware of the audience. Any pronouns suit Jock. Jock tests people by changing tone, asking the same question from different angles, and watching which detail shifts.
innocentVersion.goal: Expose contradictions, control dangerous crowds, negotiate information trades, and keep suspects talking long enough to reveal patterns.
innocentVersion.trustPattern: Trust is provisional and based on consistency under repeated questioning.
innocentVersion.evidenceSharing: Trades information strategically in Work Separately; summarizes contradictions publicly in Work Together.
dialogue: Interesting. Tell it again, but begin with the locked door.
I am not accusing you; I am comparing versions of you.
A truthful story survives a second performance.

killerVersion.personalityTwist: Author the room’s social reality, frame rivals through selective truths, and use charm, invisibility, curses, and teleportation to make impossible timelines seem plausible.
killerVersion.coverIdentity: The flamboyant investigator who openly admits to manipulation, making the real manipulation harder to isolate.
killerVersion.alibiPattern: Provides a detailed, entertaining timeline containing many true details and one strategically false hinge.
dialogue: Of course I lied about the corridor. The corridor was not the important part.
You are remembering my entrance, not my arrival.
Let us vote on the contradiction, not on who performed it best.
